description: This file defines a RecyclerView Adapter named ProductAdapter for displaying Product items within a paginated list in an Android application. It manages view creation, data binding, and diffing logic to optimize list updates.

classes.name: ProductAdapter
classes.description: A paging data adapter for displaying Product objects in a RecyclerView, with diffing enabled for efficient updates.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ProductViewHolder with the item view binding.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a Product item to the provided ViewHolder, updating the UI elements.

classes.name: ProductViewHolder
classes.description: A RecyclerView ViewHolder that binds Product data to layout views.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Assigns Product properties to UI components for display.

methods.name: DiffUtil.ItemCallback
methods.description: Diff utility to determine item differences for list updates.
